title: PerformanceSnapshot
description: Performance KPI snapshot contract for backtest/paper/live windows per detailed design §3.5.2 and §7.6.

schema_version.description: Semantic identifier for the snapshot schema release (performance.snapshot.v*).

timestamp.description: UTC ISO8601 timestamp indicating when the KPI snapshot was generated.

mode.description: Operating mode for which the KPIs were computed.

metrics.description: Aggregated KPI measurements for the snapshot window.

sharpe_ratio.description: Annualised Sharpe ratio for the snapshot window.

sortino_ratio.description: Annualised Sortino ratio for the snapshot window.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown percentage observed in the window.

win_rate.description: Fraction of profitable trades (0-1) during the window.

pnl.description: Profit and loss summary for the snapshot window.

absolute.description: Total P&L over the window in the quoted currency.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for the P&L amount.

return_pct.description: Percentage return relative to starting equity for the window.

metric_state.description: Governance review state for the KPI set (confirmed/provisional/pending/etc.).

metric_state_reason.description: Machine-readable reason code explaining the current metric_state.

rolling_volatility_pct.description: Annualised volatility percentage for the snapshot window.

profit_factor.description: Gross profit divided by gross loss for closed trades in the window.

expectancy_r.description: Average R-multiple expectancy across trades in the window.

metadata.description: Supporting metadata describing sampling windows, evidence links, and provenance.

sample_count.description: Number of qualifying executions captured in the snapshot window.

trade_days.description: Trading days represented within the snapshot window.

window.description: Temporal bounds used to compute the KPIs.

label.description: Human readable label describing the window (e.g. 90d trailing).

period.description: ISO-8601 duration string describing the lookback window.

starts_at.description: UTC ISO8601 timestamp marking the beginning of the window.

ends_at.description: UTC ISO8601 timestamp marking the end of the window.

links.description: Related evidence, reports, or runbooks tied to the snapshot.

generated_by.description: Job, CLI command, or service responsible for producing the snapshot.

source_hash.description: Hash summarising the underlying dataset or configuration inputs.

tags.description: Free-form governance or review tags applied to the snapshot.

notes.description: Optional free-form annotations captured during reviews.

link.description: Link to supporting evidence or downstream tooling.

rel.description: Relationship label describing the target resource type.

href.description: URI or repository-relative path to the supporting resource.

title.description: Human readable title for the linked resource.
